target_customer: Medicaid enrolled patients with chronic disease, paid for through health insurance billing and contracts
problem: Under 1 percent of people with diabetes receive needed training, and Medicaid patients have little at-home support. Verano delivered SMS based coaching and weekly telehealth visits.
business_model: Nonprofit billing health insurance per telehealth visit, with contracts with plans

founders.name: Karin Underwood
founders.background_notes: Founder profile says the company was formerly called CoachMe Health.

technical_complexity.rationale: A text messaging platform with scheduling and billing integration is routine engineering. The hard part was operational: clinical protocol, billing and Medicaid contracts.

defensibility.rationale: Billing codes, plan contracts and clinical protocols create some friction, but well funded digital diabetes firms could serve the same population.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not found. YC lists the company as acquired with no acquirer or date in public sources read.

market_need_then: The YC description cites 80 million Americans on Medicaid with 30 percent or more having chronic disease, and the company reported billing 186 dollars per telehealth visit with two contracts underway in 2021.

branding.domain_note: veranohealth.org, a nonprofit style domain. Fetch failed so history is unknown.

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources read. Date of rename not found

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand footprint found. Searches mostly return Verano Holdings, a cannabis company, and Verana Health, so the name is confusable.

outcome_analysis: Verano Health, formerly CoachMe Health, was a three person nonprofit SMS diabetes coaching service for Medicaid patients when it joined YC in Summer 2021, with a stated goal of financial sustainability by 2023. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date or terms and no funding history were found in public sources, so the story of why or how it ended up acquired is not public.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503. Outcome search found no acquisition coverage, only unrelated companies named Verana Health and Verano Holdings. Funding search surfaced only Verano Holdings results. Competitor search found only later or general digital diabetes firms with no dated source tied to this company, so competitors are left empty. Third party listings say the status is acquired but could not confirm the acquirer.
